payload.title: Rust auth first-sign-in app hook seam
payload.description: Crate CR-108 migration found that Frick 0.4 Rust auth routes create framework account rows and mint sessions directly, but expose no app hook equivalent to TypeScript identityProviders.onFirstSignIn. Crate needs a first-sign-in hook to create a product tenant ledger entry, _default/Tenant row, owner TenantMembership row, and product User.primaryTenantId/session tenant selection before returning the auth session. App routes cannot safely shadow built-in /auth/email/signup, /auth/apple/verify, or /auth/google/verify because framework routes are merged first and app routes are intentionally non-shadowing. Add a Rust BootSeams/AppDefinition auth lifecycle hook that runs exactly once on new account/provider/email signup, can write through FrickStore, can return/override tenantId/userId/displayName/session tenant fields, and has concurrency/idempotency semantics matching provider account creation. Crate acceptance: on first sign-in create tenant-{uuid} in the tenant ledger before schema rows; write _default Tenant(kind personal, ownerId, displayName); write _default TenantMembership owner; set product User.primaryTenantId/session tenant; leave Square location unset; returning sign-ins reuse the existing tenant.
